label: Hub Core
info:
OSC hub.

Contract:
  Devices SEND state to hub  : UDP port 9000, address /<device>/<param>, one float arg 0..1
  Hub SENDS commands to device: UDP port 9001 on the device's IP, address /<device>/set/<param>

Every incoming message updates flow.devices (registry of last-seen, IP, and latest value per param).

name: parse + registry
routing table
fill ip from registry
